card.name: Z inside BENZODIAZEPINES in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter Z partway through the capitalized word BENZODIAZEPINES in boxed-warning headings about concomitant use with CNS depressants. It also fires weakly on a few odd spots such as an opening parenthesis after an organisation name.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The Z piece in BENZODIAZEPINES in an all-caps warning list about opioids and CNS depressants.
modes.example: MEDICATION ERRORS; CYTOCHROME P450 3A4 INTERACTION; CONCOMITANT USE WITH BENZODIA<<Z>>EPINES OR OTHER CNS DEPRESSANTS

modes.label: Stray non-drug cases
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a long organisation name, or a partial word in a transliterated foreign term.
modes.example: Americans were expelled in 1966 to form the International Spartacist Tendency. The French section, now renamed the Organisation Communiste Internationaliste<< (>>OCI), fell out with the SLL

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the context.
card.plain: It lights up on the middle of the word benzodiazepines when it appears in all-capital warning headings.
